title: Multi-View 3D Reconstruction Using V-JEPA Features
abstract: arXiv:2611.15143v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Predictive video encoders provide dense visual representations, but adapting them to 3D reconstruction requires accurate depth, camera poses, and cross-view geometry. We study supervised RGB-only multi-view reconstruction using an architecture that combines video-pretrained features, camera estimation, scene aggregation, epipolar transport, and residual pointmaps. Experiments compare global and spatial camera regression with joint relative objectives on CO3D, alongside an independently trained TUM RGB-D model. On 168 CO3D five-view windows, the spatial-camera configuration achieves 29.3% lower absolute trajectory error than the global-camera configuration, but performs worse than identity poses in trajectory error and worse than the global configuration in depth error. The joint relative-objective configuration improves normalized intrinsics error and similarity-aligned Chamfer distance from 0.6447 to 0.5573, but increases raw Chamfer

translated_title: 基于V-JEPA特征的多视角三维重建
translated_abstract: 预测式视频编码器能够提供稠密的视觉表征，但将其应用于三维重建需要准确的深度、相机位姿和跨视角几何信息。我们研究了仅使用RGB的监督式多视角重建，所采用的架构结合了视频预训练特征、相机估计、场景聚合、对极传输和残差点图。实验在CO3D数据集上比较了全局相机回归与空间相机回归以及联合相对目标，并与一个独立训练的TUM RGB-D模型进行了对比。在168个CO3D五视角窗口上，空间相机配置相比全局相机配置实现了29.3%更低的绝对轨迹误差，但其轨迹误差表现不如恒等位姿，深度误差表现也不如全局配置。联合相对目标配置将归一化内参误差和相似性对齐的倒角距离从0.6447提升至0.5573，但增加了原始倒角距离误差。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种融合V-JEPA视频预训练特征、相机估计、对极传输与残差点图的仅RGB多视角三维重建架构，实验表明空间相机回归可降低29.3%的轨迹误差，而联合相对目标能改善内参估计与对齐后的重建精度。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an RGB-only multi-view 3D reconstruction architecture combining V-JEPA video-pretrained features, camera estimation, epipolar transport, and residual pointmaps, showing that spatial camera regression reduces trajectory error by 29.3% while a joint relative objective improves intrinsics estimation and aligned reconstruction accuracy.
